sections.title: Sound of the letter gé
paragraphs: The letter name is (gé) /ɡeː/. Its main sound is heard in the word (gomb) /ˈɡomb/, which means button. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: To make the first sound, press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air for a moment, then let it burst out with your voice turned on. Touch your throat to feel it shake. To make the second sound, make the same movement without your voice. Your throat does not shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter usually sounds like the consonant in (ág) /ˈaːɡ/. Before a voiceless consonant, assimilation changes the sound to the plosive heard in (megfog) /ˈmɛkfoɡ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Never say this letter like the soft sound in the English word giant. Always keep it hard, like the first sound in go. Also, remember to switch off your voice before voiceless sounds.
